finding: F-15: first-work harness reported 34/1 as shipped and validation failures under a repaired loader

measurements.run: r4 harness with preflight, runtime interpreter

root_cause: two interpreters. `python` on PATH resolves to the hermes venv (3.11.17, jsonschema 4.26.0); the runtime interpreter at .hermes-runtime\python\cpython-3.11.17-...\python.exe has no jsonschema. The harness imported whatever interpreter launched it, so the same file produced different verdicts.
